### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via SchemaRegistry (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **25** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `36429185a802dfa0ed0bfad509def0b4b5a5d5b7` — the merge of head `98bfa9de317fa46d6f62ab3725c20c39e3808cb1` into base `359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 36429185a802dfa0ed0bfad509def0b4b5a5d5b7 && git checkout 36429185a802dfa0ed0bfad509def0b4b5a5d5b7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb 98bfa9de317fa46d6f62ab3725c20c39e3808cb1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb && git merge --no-ff 98bfa9de317fa46d6f62ab3725c20c39e3808cb1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 359e935df26ddb067a9a60e2a7f81c5f80256bcb` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:发布(提升)草稿时,权限集重名判断 `permissionSetNameCollisionRefusal` 现在和它的四个兄弟判断一样,只在读到草稿时才运行。没有草稿、而另一个所有者占着这个名字时,调用方先拿到关于自己状态的 `NO_DRAFT`(404),不再是 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`(422)。另给 objectql 注册表的一个私有成员补了调用方注释。
- **为什么改**:#27535 合同审查留下的两条非阻塞建议:拒绝顺序与兄弟判断一致,私有成员改名时能在源头失败。
- **风险与回滚**:只是拒绝换拒绝。没有草稿时提升本来就不会成功;有草稿时同样的拒绝、同样的顺序。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 提升路径里 `if (draftForGate)` 那一处。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.permission-set-name-cross-package.test.ts`,预期 18/18。
- **需要你做的**:无。非受管面,席位落地。

**席位意见:** ACCEPT。按分诊把重名判断放进与兄弟一致的守卫;接受集不变。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `98bfa9de317fa46d6f62ab3725c20c39e3808cb1` · 2026-10-30T01:20Z

- **形态:** 4 files, +33/−1: one guard in `protocol.ts`, one pin, a comment-only note in objectql `registry.ts`, one changeset. No `packages/spec`, no governed path; Tier S.
- **Clause-②:** `no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`. Refusal for refusal. The seat checked that `draftForGate` is read for every type at the promotion and that `repo.promoteDraft`'s expected draft hash comes from it, so with no draft the promotion fails either way (`NO_DRAFT` or a draft conflict); no promotion that used to fail now succeeds.
- **前提实测:** the new pin red before the fix (expected `NO_DRAFT`, received `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`); ablation of the guard red, restored to the HEAD blob; the draft-plus-collision controls stay `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`.
- **门禁 check-runs:** 52 on this head: 37 success, 15 skipped, 0 other (read 2026-10-30T01:20Z); `mergeable_state: clean`. Derived gates 63/63 exit 0 after the full build, 0 NOT-MEASURED; metadata-protocol 21803 tests, objectql 9244/9244; `git merge-tree` clean against #27780 (merged since).
- **接受的偏差:** objectql's `test:repo` project left to CI Test Core (the objectql change is a comment); the report signature line.
- **范围外去向:** none.
- **散文面:** changeset and both comments checked against the diff by the seat.
